replacements.Prior lingüístico: responder por probabi: Language prior: answering from probability, not evidence
replacements.La tendencia de los modelos a generar re: The tendency of models to generate statistically likely answers from the text of the question, regardless of the actual content of the image.
replacements.Durante el preentrenamiento, el modelo a: During pretraining, the model learns answer distributions for each type of question. Those distributions act as shortcuts: for questions whose answer is highly predictable, the model generates it directly from the prior without needing the image.
replacements.Distribución de respuesta aprendida (sin: Learned answer distribution (without seeing the image)
replacements.El modelo responde <strong>\"blanco\"</s: The model answers "white" even though the car in the image is red. When the prior is strong enough, the model does not need to consult the image to generate the most likely answer.
replacements.Por qué es difícil de detectar: Why it is difficult to detect
replacements.El error es invisible cuando la distribu: The error is invisible when the statistical distribution matches the distribution of correct answers. In benchmarks where most cars are white or gray, a model without real vision can score highly using only the prior.
replacements.El experimento de ablación consiste en p: The ablation experiment presents the same question to the model with and without the image. If the answer distribution does not change significantly, the language prior dominates generation and the image is not contributing to the answer.
replacements.responde por prior, no por imagen: answers from the prior, not the image
replacements.Si la respuesta es la misma con y sin im: If the answer is the same with and without the image, the image is not contributing to generation. The model is not "seeing": it is generating from the statistical distribution learned during training. A different result between the two conditions is necessary (but not sufficient) evidence that the image influences the answer.
replacements.El efecto es especialmente marcado en ca: The effect is especially pronounced in categories where training distributions are skewed. In those categories, the statistically most likely answer is so dominant that the model disregards visual evidence even when it is present.
replacements.Los coches en datasets de imágenes cotid: Cars in everyday-image datasets are predominantly white, gray and black. The "white" prior is so strong that it can override evidence for unusual colors.
replacements.Benchmark robusto: incluir objetos con c: Robust benchmark: include objects with deliberately unusual colors for that type of object.
replacements.Si hay un solo animal visible, el prior: If only one animal is visible, the prior for "which species is most represented in similar scenes" is very strong. Dogs dominate domestic images, followed by cats. Rare species are lost.
replacements.Benchmark robusto: incluir especies poco: Robust benchmark: include species that are uncommon in the corpus in domestic or urban contexts.
replacements.\"¿Cuántos objetos hay en la imagen?\": "How many objects are in the image?"
replacements.El rango 2-4 domina en imágenes de datas: The 2–4 range dominates everyday-image datasets. When asked for the number of elements, the model tends to answer within that range regardless of what the image shows.
replacements.Benchmark robusto: incluir imágenes con: Robust benchmark: include images with quantities that violate the usual statistical range (0, 1, 7, 12, 20).
